title: Ozempic Hair Loss: What the 2026 Studies Actually Found (and What Helps)
description:
New 2026 studies link Ozempic, Wegovy and Zepbound to a modestly higher risk of hair loss. Why the shedding happens, whether it's permanent, and what helps.

Key facts:
• BMJ (July 2026): adults with type 2 diabetes on GLP-1s were 1.37 to 1.68 times as likely to be diagnosed with hair loss as those on other diabetes drugs; the extra risk is about 2-3 cases per 1,000 person-years
• NYU Langone (Sept 2026): higher GLP-1 receptor gene activity linked to about 7% higher odds of male-pattern hair loss (genetic association only)
• Most cases look like telogen effluvium, a temporary shed after rapid weight loss

Sources: https://bmjgroup.com/glp-1-diabetes-drugs-linked-to-increased-risk-of-hair-loss/ · https://nyulangone.org/news/some-hair-loss-men-linked-use-weight-loss-drugs · https://www.sciencemediacentre.org/expert-reaction-to-a-target-trial-emulation-study-on-risk-of-hair-loss-associated-with-glp-1-ras-in-adults-with-type-2-diabetes/

script.say: Hey guys! Losing hair on Ozempic, Wegovy or Zepbound? Here's what the 2026 studies actually found.

A July 2026 BMJ study found people with type 2 diabetes on GLP-1s were between 1.37 and 1.68 times as likely to be diagnosed with hair loss. But the extra risk is small: roughly two or three cases per thousand people a year.
script.title: Linked, but modestly
points: BMJ, Jul 2026: 1.37-1.68x as likely to be diagnosed
Extra risk: about 2-3 cases per 1,000 people a year
An association, not proof the drug causes it

script.say: Most of it looks like telogen effluvium: a temporary shed triggered by fast weight loss and eating less. It usually grows back once your weight steadies.
script.title: Usually a temporary shed
points: Triggered by fast weight loss and eating less

script.say: What helps: eat enough protein, lose weight at a steadier pace, and check your iron. And don't stop your GLP-1 on your own.
script.title: Protect your hair
points: Lose weight at a steadier pace
Don't stop your GLP-1 on your own

script.say: Receding hairline or thinning crown? That's pattern loss, and it needs its own treatment. Full breakdown on treatments hub dot com.
